title: Revelation of potential bioactive water-soluble Boc-L-valine and imidazole appended metal complexes M = Co(II), Cu(II) & Zn(II): synthesis, characterization, ct-DNA binding, pBR322 cleavage, SOD mimetic, and cytotoxicity studies.
authors: Akhter, Suffora; Khursheed, Salman; Arjmand, Farukh; Tabassum, Sartaj
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金属配合物与ct-DNA的沟槽静电结合及切割活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为小分子金属配合物而非转录因子，且方法以实验表征为主，仅辅以DFT和分子对接，与TF-DNA结合机制建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Bio-compatible water-soluble conjugates of Co(II), Cu(II) and Zn(II) (1-3), [Co(Boc-L-valine)(2)(imidazole)(2)], [Cu(Boc-L-valine)(2)(imidazole)(2)], and [Zn(Boc-L-valine)(2)(imidazole)(2)], were synthesized and comprehensively characterized by various spectroscopic techniques (UV-visible, FT-IR, ESI-MS, EPR, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR) and single crystal X-ray diffraction which showed that the complexes 1-3 crystallized in an orthorhombic crystal system, in a slightly distorted octahedral geometry having the space group P2(1)2(1)2. Density functional theory calculations were performed to correlate the energy of frontier molecular orbitals with the stability and reactivity of the complexes. In vitro DNA binding interaction studies of complexes were performed by employing various biophysical techniques and their corroborative results revealed (i) the electrostatic mode of binding in the groove region of DNA, (ii) pBR322 plasmid cleavage at a low concentration of 5-12.5 muM via an oxidative pathway in complexes 1 and 2 and the hydrolytic mechanism in the case of 3, (iii) changes in the (1)H NMR chemical shift values of the NH(2) group of GMP after interaction with complex 3, (iv) alteration in the EPR parameters of complex 2 after complexation with DNA, (v) SOD mimetic activity of complex 2 with the IC(50) value of 2.08 muM and (vi) a good and selective cytotoxicity profile against chemo-resistant MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 cancer cell lines by complex 1. Molecular docking studies complemented the spectroscopic results and confirmed the electrostatic interaction of complexes in the groove region of DNA.
abstract_zh: 合成了Co(II)、Cu(II)和Zn(II)的生物相容性水溶性共轭物（1-3），即[Co(Boc-L-缬氨酸)(2)(咪唑)(2)]、[Cu(Boc-L-缬氨酸)(2)(咪唑)(2)]和[Zn(Boc-L-缬氨酸)(2)(咪唑)(2)]，并通过多种光谱技术（紫外-可见光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、电喷雾电离质谱、电子顺磁共振、1H NMR、13C NMR）和单晶X射线衍射进行了全面表征，结果表明配合物1-3在正交晶系中结晶，具有略微畸变的八面体几何构型，空间群为P2(1)2(1)2。进行了密度泛函理论计算，以关联前沿分子轨道的能量与配合物的稳定性和反应性。通过多种生物物理技术对配合物进行了体外DNA结合相互作用研究，其佐证结果揭示了：(i) DNA沟槽区域的静电结合模式；(ii) 配合物1和2在5-12.5 μM低浓度下通过氧化途径切割pBR322质粒，而配合物3则通过水解机制；(iii) 配合物3与GMP相互作用后，GMP的NH(2)基团的1H NMR化学位移值发生变化；(iv) 配合物2与DNA复合后，其EPR参数发生改变；(v) 配合物2具有SOD模拟活性，IC(50)值为2.08 μM；(vi) 配合物1对化疗耐药性MCF-7和MDA-MB-231癌细胞系表现出良好且选择性的细胞毒性。分子对接研究补充了光谱结果，并确认了配合物在DNA沟槽区域的静电相互作用。
